name: Default
shortDescription: Monitoring, statistics and notifications for Plex Media Server: watch history, stream activity, user stats and newsletters.

alerts.message: On first start Tautulli generates a temporary login and prints it in the container logs under "Setup wizard login" (username tautulli). Sign in with it, then finish the setup wizard: set your own username and password, sign in with your Plex account and pick a Plex Media Server that is reachable from this server.
